startUrls.title: URLs
startUrls.description: Pages to convert (each URL is fetched once; no crawling).

extractionMode.title: Extraction mode
extractionMode.description: 'Main content' falls back to full page automatically when no article is found.

includeTables.title: Keep tables
includeTables.description: Convert HTML tables to Markdown tables. Turn off to drop tables from the output.

chunkSize.title: Chunk size (characters, 0 = off)
chunkSize.description: Also return the Markdown split into heading/paragraph-aware chunks for embeddings/RAG.

chunkOverlap.title: Chunk overlap (characters)
chunkOverlap.description: Number of characters repeated between consecutive chunks, so context is not lost at chunk boundaries.

includeRawHtml.title: Include raw HTML
includeRawHtml.description: Also store the original HTML of each page in the dataset. Makes items much larger.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of pages fetched in parallel.

timeoutSecs.title: Timeout per page (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: How long to wait for each page to download.
